annotations.text:
Four mature directions, same screen. Pick one and I build the remaining five pages in it.

All four make the same UX cut: the old Overview stacked fifteen blocks at equal weight, these show five — net worth, four vitals, one decision, one agent log. Labels are plain English: 'Free each month', not 'Monthly surplus'.

A — INSTRUMENT
Swiss precision. Cool neutrals, hairline rules, one slate-blue accent, tight grid. Archivo throughout, tabular figures.

Most credible, least decorated. Risk: can read as austere.

B — PRIVATE BANK
Dark ink, warm off-white type, bronze accent, Newsreader serif for every figure. Jost for UI.

The most expensive-looking. Risk: dark again, and serif numerals are less scannable than tabular sans.

C — BROADSHEET
Editorial. Bodoni Moda numerals, heavy top rule, dateline, ranked items. Libre Franklin body.

Strongest personality, and it fits an app that makes arguments. Risk: the didone is fashion-sensitive.

D — ATELIER
Soft depth. Rounded cards, gentle shadows, deep green accent, Manrope. Closest to a modern product.

Safest and most familiar. Risk: familiar is also forgettable — closest to generic SaaS.
